official.deadline_note: Admission deadline 20 January 2027, but earlier for some programmes (10 December 2026 for high-selectivity programmes, 13 January 2027 for others); second PAA sitting deadline 16 January 2027; results 18 February 2027; place-reservation payment due 25 February 2027; award acceptance due 4 March 2027; deadline to request the Beca Socioeconómica complement 30 March 2027.
official.status_note: The official page states the call is published once a year for new entrants to the August-December semester; applications open 24 August 2026 and the call closes 22 January 2027.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Published wording: 'La beca puede otorgar un apoyo de entre 40% y 60% sobre el costo de la colegiatura, válido para el campus al que hayas sido admitido' (the scholarship can award support of between 40% and 60% of the tuition cost, valid for the campus to which the applicant was admitted).
official.funding_period: 40%-60% of tuition cost, per academic period

Option of a complement of up to a further 30% through the Beca Socioeconómica, without exceeding 80% total support, subject to Scholarships Committee approval

Have been admitted to begin a professional programme or career at the Tecnológico de Monterrey in August 2027

Apply within the official dates of the call

Hold an average of at least 90/100 over the complete or accumulated grades of the first two years of bachillerato or high school (for three-year programmes), or the equivalent for other study modalities

Be admitted to start a professional programme or career at the Tecnológico de Monterrey in August 2027

PAA result of at least 1,360 points, or the converted SAT/ACT equivalent
Completed scholarship application inside the admission application on solicitud.tec.mx (Becas y Apoyos Educativos section)

Optional complement of up to a further 30% through the Beca Socioeconómica, capped at 80% total support
application_method: Register and start, or use an existing, Solicitud de Admisión at solicitud.tec.mx
Schedule and sit the Prueba de Aptitud Académica (PAA); a second sitting is allowed up to 16 January 2027 to reach the 1,360 minimum
Confirm that the published call requirements are met
From 24 August 2026 open the Becas y Apoyos Educativos section, run the profile evaluation and select the scholarship option
Submit the application on a single date and only for the campus to which admission was granted
official.application_route: Apply inside the admission application on solicitud.tec.mx: open Becas y Apoyos Educativos, run the profile evaluation, select the scholarship, and submit once for the admitted campus.
official.study_mode: Full-time professional programme (conservation requires taking the complete academic load)
official.citizenship_residency: Reserved for applicants coming from schools in the listed countries: El Salvador, Colombia, Bolivia, Nicaragua, Peru, Costa Rica, Panama, Dominican Republic, Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Venezuela, Honduras, Ecuador, Guatemala, Paraguay, Uruguay, Cuba, Trinidad and Tobago, Puerto Rico and Haiti
official.international_eligibility: Yes - this is the international variant of the academic talent scholarship, reserved for candidates from the listed Latin American and Caribbean countries
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Any professional programme at the admitted campus; the Médico Cirujano, B.A. in Finance and B.A. in Strategy and Business Transformation programmes have a specific scholarship quota
official.duration: Entrance award for a professional degree beginning in August 2027; the percentage applies in each academic period while the holder meets the conservation requirements (pass all subjects, take the full academic load, participate in the Programa de Becarios, keep an average of at least 85/100)
official.description: The Beca al Talento Académico Internacional is the Tecnológico de Monterrey award that, in the university's own framing, recognises young people with extraordinary academic performance, aimed at applicants from schools in 21 named Latin American and Caribbean countries who can receive support of between 40% and 60% of the tuition cost, valid for the campus to which they were admitted, in a call published once a year for new entrants to the August-December semester.

applicant_utility.summary: Treat this as a large tuition discount rather than a full ride: you still pay 40-60% of the colegiatura, the place-reservation fee and every living cost in Mexico, so budget the full stack before accepting. The sequence is unforgiving - you must win admission first (generally 20 January 2027, but 10 December 2026 for high-selectivity programmes) and only then submit the single scholarship application that closes on 22 January 2027; winning is then conditional on paying the reservation by 25 February 2027 and accepting by 4 March 2027. Ranking uses your PAA score (hard minimum 1,360) together with your previous average, so a below-target first sitting is recoverable through the second PAA on 16 January 2027, but nothing after results on 18 February 2027 is appealable. If your family's economic context justifies it, the Beca Socioeconómica complement can add up to 30% within an 80% cap if requested by 30 March 2027, though it cannot be combined with any other talent award.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-performing students from the 21 listed Latin American and Caribbean countries, under 21 years old, averaging 90+/100, with a strong PAA result, who have already been admitted to a Tec professional programme for August 2027.
application_readiness_checklist: Check your school country against the published 21-country list first - eligibility fails immediately if it is not there
Book the PAA early and treat 1,360 as a hard gate; if you fall short, secure the re-sit that must be completed by 16 January 2027
Get an official copy of your bachillerato or high school transcript ready to upload before the call window opens
Secure admission on your programme's real deadline rather than the general one - 10 December 2026 for high-selectivity programmes, 13 January 2027 for many others
Open Becas y Apoyos Educativos inside solicitud.tec.mx after 24 August 2026 and submit once, only for the campus that admitted you
Put the post-result dates in your calendar now: reservation payment 25 February 2027, acceptance 4 March 2027
common_rejection_risks: Coming from a country or school outside the published 21-country list, which this call is strictly limited to
PAA below 1,360, or an SAT/ACT score whose conversion does not reach the same 1,360 threshold
Turning 21 before the moment of application
Relying on the 20 January 2027 general admission date when the chosen programme actually closed on 10 December 2026 or 13 January 2027
Still sitting on a programme waiting list when the call closes, which removes you from the scholarship call even with top grades
Missing the 25 February 2027 reservation payment, which cancels an award you had already won
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The 40-60% share of tuition the award does not cover, the non-transferable place-reservation payment, entirely self-funded living costs in Mexico (housing, food, transport, insurance) and any programme-specific admission costs; no living, travel or installation support is published.
document_audit: The transcript must be an official copy of the bachillerato/high school record, covering the first two years if the programme is three years
The PAA result of at least 1,360 must be in your file - two attempts are allowed, but the qualifying one must be secured before the call closes
There is no separate scholarship portal: if the Becas y Apoyos Educativos section of the admission application is never completed, your entry does not exist
Applying on more than one date or for more than one campus voids the submission - the call is one campus, one date
alerts: Admission must be secured before the scholarship application, so the real bottleneck is your programme's admission deadline, not the 22 January 2027 closing date
The Médico Cirujano, B.A. in Finance and B.A. in Strategy and Business Transformation programmes carry a specific scholarship quota and require admission by 10 December 2026
Results published on 18 February 2027 are final and non-appealable, with no feedback process
Keeping the award requires an 85/100 average, all subjects passed, the full academic load and Programa de Becarios participation, so an entrance win does not guarantee renewal
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Win admission first, then inside the solicitud.tec.mx admission application open Becas y Apoyos Educativos, run the profile evaluation, choose the scholarship and submit a single application for your admitted campus before the 22 January 2027 close.

official_details.selection_process: Winners are selected from among applicants who meet the call requirements, based on the PAA score and the average of previous studies; ties are resolved by the holistic evaluation of the Admissions office; the number of awards is limited; the Tec reserves the right to declare the award deserted; the evaluation and allocation decision is final and non-appealable with no feedback process after results are published; any situation not foreseen is resolved by the Comités de Becas.
conservation_requirements: Pass all subjects or units of the academic period and the intensive courses
Participate satisfactorily in the Programa de Becarios with academic or formative activities related to the enrolled programme
Obtain a scholarship average of at least 85/100 in the academic period and the intensive courses completed
official_details.socioeconomic_complement_terms: If the Beca al Talento Académico is obtained and the evaluation of the family's economic context justifies additional support, a complement of up to 30% may be received through the Beca Socioeconómica without exceeding 80% total support; the complement is subject to the evaluation and approval of the Scholarships Committee, is exclusive to the Beca al Talento Académico and cannot be combined with other talent awards; 30 March 2027 is the deadline for the Beca Socioeconómica to be considered as a complement.
